_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of three Microsoft Graph documentation source pages that hold Microsoft's own PIM for Groups request samples: Create eligibilityScheduleRequest and Create assignmentScheduleRequest (privilegedAccess/group), and Update rules in PIM by using Microsoft Graph. Learn has no end-to-end PIM for Groups tutorial; the samples exist only inside these pages. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn samples: PIM for Groups schedule requests and PIM policy rule updates (Microsoft Graph v1.0)
license: Documentation: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (LICENSE). Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Both copied from the repository root. Attribution: Microsoft, microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib.
not_copied: Everything else in microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib, including the include files the pages pull in for the permissions tables and the C#, Go, Java, JavaScript, PHP, PowerShell and Python snippets (api-reference/v1.0/includes): the HTTP requests are inline in these pages and are what the chapter runs; the permissions are read from the rendered Learn pages and cited there.
